instruction: In poor-pigs the per-pig base is one too small. Use (+ 2 ...) instead of (+ 1 ...).
input:
(define (poor-pigs buckets minutesToDie minutesToTest)
  (exact-ceiling (log buckets (+ 1 (/ minutesToTest minutesToDie)))))
expected:
(define (poor-pigs buckets minutesToDie minutesToTest)
  (exact-ceiling (log buckets (+ 2 (/ minutesToTest minutesToDie)))))
